title: Bahao Ashqe Aza Fatima ka Hai Matam
body:
Bahao ashq-e-aza Fatima ka hai matam
Ho nauha binte payambar ka ham se kaise raqm, larazte jaate hain alfaaz kanpta hai qalam, ye kaise Fatima zehra pe toote zulm-o-sitam, sada ye goonj rahi hai fizaon mein paiham
Nabi ki qabar pa ye bain karti thi zehra, main ab sunaongi rudad-e-gham kise baba, hain pasliyan meri tooti sanbhalo mujhko zara, bulalo paas mujhe apne hoga mujh pe karam
Ali se Fatima zehra ne phir ye farmaya, karein maafh agar hogayi ho mujh se qata, qayal rakhna mere baad mere bachchon ka, ke unka ab nahin koi bhi monis-o-hamdam
<<DIVIDER>>
Sitam uthai thein har aan rehti thein muztar, hui shahadat-e-Mohsin gira jo pehlu pe dar, yatim-o-bekas o mazloom binte paygham, bargayeen zamane se bibi utha ke ranj-o-alam
Janaza Fatima zehra ka shab ki taariki, Ali se binte nabi ki yahi wasiyat thi, zamana badla hai kaisa ye kaisi ayi ghadi, usi ki betiyanbalwe me ayeen waye sitam
Rasheed hota tha jis dar pa ayaton ka nuzool, wo bibi jis ne na paya sukoon baad-e-rasool, pidar ke gham mein jo rehti thi subah-o-Shaam malool, usi ka ahl-e-aza kar rahe hain ab mata..
